projects.name: Vega site
projects.quote: Vega Site: The Company continued groundwork at the 205 MW Vega site, which is expected to house the ~15 EH/s colocation deployment of the ● BITMAIN U3S21EXPH.

projects.name: Highrise AI GPU-as-a-Service cluster, Chicago
projects.quote: The cluster comprises multiple Hewlett Packard Enterprise Cray supercomputers powered by 1,000 NVIDIA H100 GPUs.

projects.name: ASIC Fleet Upgrade
projects.quote: ASIC Fleet Upgrade: The Company signed a purchase agreement with BITMAIN on November 6, 2024 to upgrade approximately 111 MW of self-mining capacity across its existing fleet in Q1 2025.
